question.default: Which option best describes this record?

input_fields.title: Literal record fields (JSON list; [] assesses all)

graph_representation.format: StudioGraphRecord closed union: header/group/node/data-edge/control-edge/interfaces/typed-group-assignments/typed-sweeps/literal-nodes. No opaque graph blob; no public Any/JSON parameter map.
graph_representation.identity: Source keys use same-draft scope plus decoded exact source identifier string, not identity of scalar ref. These are data forward references, not guessed future node-issued handles. Root scope and globally defined group bodies distinct. Seal resolves all refs; missing, duplicate semantic keys, foreign draft/generation/purpose and cycles refuse. Read projections use node-issued source/expanded handles from exact immutable snapshot.
graph_representation.scalar_purpose: Dedicated scalar refs encode ONLY actual long source strings or arbitrary integers, fixed to draft+owner-record+purpose+subordinal and exact eventual schema slot. Ref reuse/retag across slots, graph/title/metric/candidate/output/other-resource is forbidden; no interpretation of scalar as graph/control/parameter object. Managed model/dataset bindings retain exact original source_id scalar alongside current authorized managed ref for source reconstruction.
graph_representation.scalar_transport: Utf8Chunk transports ASCII bytes of JSON string content (without enclosing quotes) or signed decimal integer. Dedicated authoritative source decoder preserves Python codepoint sequence incl lone surrogates; no Rust String lossy bridge, Unicode normalization, trim or shared Utf8Chunk invariant relaxation. Original source json.loads may combine escaped high+low pair; preserve resulting actual codepoints, not preparse token spelling. Signed decimal normalized lexically; no U64/arbitrary fixed-digit narrowing.
graph_representation.literal_positions: Flat tree only header id/name/description/layout, group/node name metadata and actual record.map literal/record.if comparison values. Container nodes plus parent/ordinal/object-key/child-count bind SAME draft+purpose+owner+tree. No generic node parameter, bindings, code, URL, destination, tool route or graph envelope via literal tree.
graph_representation.literal_validation: Iterative admitted traversal, exact one root/parent, no dangling refs/cycles/shared subtree or scalar loops/amplification; unique decoded object keys, contiguous array/map ordinals and exact child counts. Apply whole source budget and private Node-owned admission to transient+retained records before allocation/traversal. No new public quota profile or authority. Record literals additionally enforce record_ops source depth and serialized UTF8 bounds.
graph_representation.config_closure: Exactly31 catalogue config variants plus source GroupInstance; normalized config excludes GroupInstance. Each has fixed params/bindings, explicit omission and field order. Source invalid types/null/unknown parameter do not normalize into accepted config; historical invalid drafts remain nonexecuting control-storage data, not valid canonical IR. Nonliteral arbitrary layout remains data-only AST.
graph_representation.phase: ReadRecord is Source(StudioGraphRecord)|Expanded(StudioGraphExpandedRecord). Snapshot form and node-issued schema must match exactly, no source append of expanded objects. Sealed receipt binds separate source/expanded snapshots+control graph refs. Expanded node config defaults filled and normalized fields present; no source omission promoted as ready. Source refs available for invalid control drafts remain data only.
graph_representation.parameter_binding: Every parameter assignment discriminant binds exact operation+parameter, typed value and exact eventual target NodeKey. Group exposed assignment/sweep names also bind declared interface and resolved target. Refusal of mismatched operation/slot/type prevents generic Value+unchecked key bag. Unused groups validated too; alias cycles missing targets refuse. Multiple exposed aliases to same slot follow actual _expand override loop: source group-instance parameter insertion order, later override wins, after original child params; do not invent duplicate-target refusal where source orders overrides. Nested interfaces resolved recursively. Sweeps apply after expansion in expanded node order then insertion-order parameter/value sequence.
graph_representation.relationships: Scoped unique simple source identifiers; fixed catalogue port enum/group declaration refs; source/target order preserved; one data edge per target, compatible refined types/required inputs, no gate-as-data. Controls gate only, group target expands descendants, required group-control inputs nonempty/uniquely provided; duplicate expanded targets/edges refuse. Combined data+control DAG and source record_coverage rules required.
graph_representation.metadata_order: Top/group/node/param/binding fixed field-order lists bounded by actual fixed schema field counts, not invented dataset caps. Endpoint/source-target/record-assignment ordering booleans preserve source two-key order. Explicit maps and arrays carry insertion ordinal; canonical record traversal never overwrites source ordinal metadata. Presence inferred from field-order membership, all corresponding fields/records must agree; absent and empty distinct.

graph_source_size.metric: len(json.dumps(graph)) <= 2000000, default ensure_ascii=True/default spaced separators; ASCII output length, not raw upload bytes and not compact store digest. Whole logical graph including all unused groups/metadata/string content counted.

raw_and_expanded_nodes.metric: Raw root nodes<=1000; each expansion/sweep rejects >1000; sweeping multiplies entire graph by Cartesian ordered value lengths, not one-node-only copies.

group_depth.predicate: len(stack)>16 refuses; group recursion only, not global JSON depth16.

execution_hint.metric: nonempty str; no authority conveyed by device hint.

record_controls.encoding: json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False).encode(utf-8), includes exact original object order. Source lone-surrogate UTF8 failure is refusal, not replacement.

source_equality.definition: Reconstruct ordered logical Python JSON value after actual authoritative source decoder. Preserve omitted/default, exact codepoints, integer-vs-float, finite IEEE754 bits including negative zero; bool is not numeric. Original whitespace/number token spelling is not retained by actual json.loads. JSON source duplicate last-key-wins is observed adapter behavior only; canonical typed records refuse duplicate semantic fields. A SINGLE source decode supplies authority checks, source hash/size, defaults and validation, never divergent security dispatcher parsing.

source_profiles.canonical_order: Header, groups in source map insertion order, body node arrays, per-node declared fields with original field ordinals, edge/control arrays, interfaces and sweeps in source insertion order, literal preorder. Source hash sort_keys is distinct from operational sweep order. No order inferred from arrival that contradicts explicit source ordinals.

selection_semantics.definition: All or actual source node/group subtree, expanded node or original variant family selector. Resolve groups+variants then close ancestors across BOTH data and control DAGs. Snapshot pins same validated source+expanded+catalog/schema and current caller auth; deterministic source expansion order, no flat1000-ID substitute for source semantics. Read items carry direct/group/variant/data/control ancestry reason and node mapping; every item/range/error current-authorized, invalidated cursor observable Resync; empty/complete snapshot observable.

durable_mutation_semantics.definition: Every durable request carries request_id and exact Node-owned generation; CAS where mutable. Immutable request payload/principal/draft/position bound result, changed payload refuses, repeats never duplicate/extend storage. Failed seal returns Invalid/Unsupported/Recovery, no executable ref and no successful result cached. Late cancelled/detached request may already have durable winner; request-detach only. Existing private ResourceAdmission node-owner accounting governs both retained and transient graph/scalar/literal/expansion storage before growth; no caller-raised budget, public quota switch or fresh framework.

security_boundary: Current authenticated principal/project/board/pool/resource incarnation checked before any existence disclosure; current revocation fences every record/range/error. Labels/references are not grants.

Managed DatasetRef resolves author-owned actual custody/materialization/snapshot policy; ModelRef same actual authorization. Legacy source IDs never imply file path, URL or private resource existence entitlement.

Validation/save/catalog/template/sweep/literal/execution hint cannot grant run, network, packages, code, worker routing or tools.call execution. Exact fixed node implementation and separately authorized tool/resource/run admission remain mandatory.
Node-issued semantic purpose/version/digest is verified, never caller-retagged. Draft invalid history may be stored but cannot receive canonical executable seal.
unresolved_enablement: Declarations only: no actual canonical IR dispatcher, parser, cross-record validator, scalar storage, durable retry/CAS, snapshots, private-admission integration, selector implementation or UI caller migration. No runtime/native/retained-journey/K acceptance.

Mandatory serializer/decoder vectors: exact CPython json defaults/spaces/escaping including control/lone/high-low/nonBMP codepoints, integer rendering/runtime digit refusal, FiniteF64 subnormal/negativezero/exponent formatting, bool/int/float comparisons/defaults and sorted store hash vs insertion operational order. Named profiles are not enforcement; unavailable before these are implemented and reviewed.

Mandatory relationship/expansion vectors: all31 parameter defaults/ranges/required gym environment, group alias override ordering/cycles/unused definitions, source group/control interfaces, combined data/control cycles, required inputs/refined types, sweep Cartesian order and 1000 boundaries, record_coverage and full source/group/variant selection ancestor closure.

Unbounded source record/edge/interface/literal count and total transient/retained amplification require Node-owned admission profiles; no invented1024-list cap. Generic JSON layout depth is not group16 or record16; exact aggregate iterative source/parser constraints must be closed before enablement.

DatasetRef integration awaits separately reviewed dataset leaf; no duplicate definition or private dataset worker ref. Shared ModelRef and StudioControl refs reused as data. Source-derived catalogue extraction is metadata only, no product imports/models/tests.

Public operation-specific metrics and per-node outputs/value schema is mandatory next same-author continuation, not closed by this graph leaf. Control leaf remains partial until actual implementation/callers as well as graph/metrics/value closure.

Packages/import/resource install and durable sources/subscriptions/destinations/deliveries remain exact route-mapped separate segments in studio_control evidence; no omission or new authority through graph strings.

No declaration blocker. No semantic validator/CPython serializer/expansion/caller/runtime/K proof; named gaps remain enablement prerequisites.
